reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment: I bought this for my son so he had a microphone for his computer system instead of using a headset or AirPods. I purchased at the same time as a microphone. It attaches to a desk very easily, he’s had this for several months now and it’s working great! Exactly what he needed. Telescopes out pretty far and when you adjust it, it doesn’t lose The level where it adjusted to, it stays where you put it. Excellent purchase
reviews.author: JMalocu
